about_the_game:
Parasite Echo is a third-person survival horror game that blends atmospheric exploration, tense combat, and puzzle-solving inside a derelict space facility consumed by a mysterious alien infection.

Trapped in isolation above the clouds, you'll play as Cira, a lone responder who must navigate the decaying corridors of CANOPY-6 — a once-botanical research ship now overrun by hostile lifeforms and corrupted machines.

  • Explore labyrinthine halls filled with overgrown alien coral and fragments of a forgotten past.

  • Fight infected creatures and malfunctioning security units using scarce resources.

  • Solve environmental puzzles to restore power, access sealed zones, and piece together the truth.

  • Survive the growing presence of something deeper... something that knows your name.

content_descriptors.notes: There are themes related to reproduction/sex, so the game may include sex scenes involving both humans and non-humans.
